extracted.name: Brownie peanut butter cookies 😊
extracted.description: Great recipe for Brownie peanut butter cookies 😊.
ingredient_lines: 3/4 cup peanut butter,1/3 cup cocoa pwd
instruction_lines: Cream the butter n sugar until fluffy then add eggs,vanilla essence n peanut butter n mix well now sieve flour/cocoa n baking soda n mix the mixture well wit a wooden spoon. Now take scoop by scoop n place on a baking tray.make sure u put a butter paper n then ur cookies to bake.i bake 180° for 10 min for each batch. U can do acc to ur oven temperature. After the cookies are out n cooled.put some melted chocolate on each cookies.ur kids will love them.today I made them again so post pic.
Do as above. Just post pictures so it could help.
